name: fleetbase
description: Modular logistics and supply chain operating system (LSOS)
readme_summary: Fleetbase is a modular logistics and supply chain operating system designed to streamline management, planning, optimization, and operational control. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for e-commerce, retail, courier services, field services, and enterprise logistics, with a focus on developers to extend and customize its capabilities.
primary_use_case: To provide a comprehensive, modular, and customizable operating system for managing and optimizing logistics and supply chain operations across various industries.
cover_image_prompt: A bustling, futuristic cityscape where glowing digital pathways connect various points of interest like warehouses, delivery hubs, and customer locations. A central, stylized dashboard interface hovers above, displaying real-time order statuses, optimized routes, and fleet movements as dynamic, interconnected nodes. Small, stylized delivery drones and vehicles navigate these pathways. The overall mood is efficient and organized, with a clean, modern aesthetic. Subtle elements like data streams flowing between nodes and the 'Fleetbase' logo integrated into the dashboard would reinforce the concept of a connected, intelligent logistics system. Rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a vibrant, tech-focused color palette.

name: check-if-email-exists
description: Check if an email address exists without sending any email, written in Rust. Comes with a ⚙️ HTTP backend.
readme_summary: This Rust repository provides a library and an HTTP backend to check if an email address is deliverable without sending an actual email. It supports programmatic usage in Rust projects, a Dockerized backend for API access, and a command-line interface.
key_features: Email existence check without sending emails
primary_use_case: Verifying the existence of email addresses for applications and services, preventing bounces and improving email campaign efficiency.
cover_image_prompt: A digital detective, wearing a magnifying glass that glows with data streams, is carefully examining an email envelope floating in a void. The envelope has a question mark on it. As the detective focuses, the question mark transforms into a clear checkmark, emitting a soft green light, indicating the email address is valid. Subtle lines of code and network nodes are visible in the background, suggesting the underlying technology. The repository name 'check-if-email-exists' is subtly integrated into a digital display on the detective's wrist. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, futuristic aesthetic and a vibrant blue and green color palette.

name: no-ai-slop
description: Removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from any piece of writing.
readme_summary: No AI Slop is a Python-based tool designed to identify and remove over 20 common patterns of 'AI slop' from written text. It aims to preserve the author's personal voice and writing style while cleaning up generic, repetitive, or overly formulaic language often produced by AI.
key_features: Preserves personal voice and writing style
Can detect AI slop patterns without guessing authorship
Can generate AI slop for satirical purposes
Available as a ChatGPT plugin and installable via npx
primary_use_case: To clean and refine written content by removing generic AI-like phrasing, ensuring the text retains a unique and personal voice.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous editor, depicted as a skilled artisan, carefully chiseling away generic, repetitive stone blocks from a vibrant, uniquely carved statue that represents an author's personal voice. The discarded blocks are labeled with common AI phrases like 'It's not X, it's Y' and 'What nobody tells you'. The artisan uses specialized tools that subtly resemble code or UI elements, with digital particles flowing from them. The background is a clean, modern studio with soft, focused lighting, highlighting the transformation from generic to unique. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, bright color palette, emphasizing clarity and transformation.

name: AdGuardHome
description: Network-wide ads & trackers blocking DNS server
readme_summary: AdGuard Home is an open-source, network-wide DNS server designed to block ads and trackers across all devices on a home network without requiring client-side software. It functions by intercepting DNS requests and redirecting malicious or ad-serving domains to a null route.
key_features: Blocks ads and tracking by re-routing domains to a 'black hole'
primary_use_case: To provide a network-wide solution for blocking advertisements and tracking across all connected devices within a home network by acting as a custom DNS server.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, friendly guardian robot standing at the entrance of a vibrant, bustling digital city. The robot holds a large, glowing shield that filters incoming data streams, represented as colorful packets. Malicious packets, depicted as dark, spiky shapes, are deflected by the shield and dissolve into digital dust. Safe packets, shown as bright, smooth orbs, pass through the shield into the city. Subtle UI elements showing 'AdGuard Home' and 'Block List' are visible on the robot's arm. The overall mood is protective and clean, with a bright, optimistic color palette. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear, bold lines and a focus on the protective metaphor.

name: SIMURG
description: Zero-leak online detection of LLM decoding corruption and Free Web Search for your AI agents! Catch repetition loops, language drift and garbage mid-stream, before the user sees a bad token. Works with any OpenAI-compatible API.
readme_summary: SIMURG is a Python library designed to detect and prevent LLM decoding corruption in real-time during text generation. It monitors the token stream for anomalies like repetition, language drift, or garbage output, allowing for mid-stream abortion and regeneration before the corrupted text reaches the user. It is compatible with any OpenAI-compatible API and operates efficiently without requiring a GPU.
key_features: Real-time detection of LLM decoding corruption
Low detection latency (~590 chars past onset)
Minimal footprint (NumPy only, no model, no GPU)
primary_use_case: To ensure the integrity and quality of text generated by Large Language Models in production environments by detecting and preventing decoding corruption in real-time.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant digital guardian, represented as a stylized, glowing shield, stands before a flowing river of text tokens. The river is initially clear and orderly, but as it approaches the guardian, sections begin to visibly corrupt, turning into chaotic scribbles and repeating patterns. The guardian actively intercepts these corrupted segments, causing them to dissolve into digital dust before they can reach a waiting, expectant user silhouette on the other side. Subtle UI elements showing real-time anomaly detection metrics and a small 'SIMURG' logo are integrated into the guardian's design. The scene is set against a dark, futuristic background with a clean, modern aesthetic, emphasizing the guardian's protective role. Style: 3D isometric illustration with vibrant, contrasting colors for corrupted vs. clean text.

name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: Unofficial desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness. Background service, tray icon, update prompts. Bundles Node and the harness, so nothing else needs installing. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.
readme_summary: This repository provides an unofficial desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness, bundling the necessary Node.js runtime and package manager. It adds background service capabilities, a system tray icon for easy management, and prompts for updates, simplifying the user experience for DeepSeek Harness without requiring separate installations.
key_features: System tray icon with quit functionality
No external dependencies required for installation
primary_use_case: To provide a user-friendly, self-contained desktop application for running and managing the DeepSeek Harness, including background operation and update notifications.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot assistant holding a glowing orb labeled 'DeepSeek Harness'. The robot is standing next to a small, sleek desktop computer that has a subtle system tray icon visible on its screen. The orb emits gentle light, illuminating a path from a cloud (representing updates) towards the robot. The background is a clean, modern workspace with soft, ambient lighting. Small, abstract data streams flow around the robot, hinting at the underlying technology. The overall mood is helpful and efficient, emphasizing ease of use and automated management. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, friendly aesthetic and vibrant, but not overwhelming, colors. The repository name 'DSH Desktop' is subtly integrated into the scene, perhaps on a small plaque near the robot.
